label: Observation
definition: A recorded signal on imaging, fluid assay, clinical examination, physiology, genetics, or tissue

label: Phenotype
definition: A reproducibly described pattern of observations

label: Target pathology
definition: The vessel-wall or tissue condition the investigation aims to identify

label: Mechanism
definition: A proposed causal process linking exposures, vessel injury, tissue injury, and outcomes

label: Biomarker
definition: A measured characteristic used for a defined context of use

label: Diagnostic criterion
definition: A rule estimating disease probability in a defined population and presentation

label: Reference standard
definition: The method used to determine target-condition status
must_not_be_equated_with: Perfect truth when sampling is incomplete

label: Outcome
definition: A future event or state the model seeks to predict or change

label: Clinical action
definition: A decision integrating evidence, values, alternatives, and competing risks
